import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static int maxn = 5005;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d, int e) {
            from = a; to = b; cap = c; flow = d; cost = e;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        int n;
        ArrayList<Edge> e;
        ArrayList<Integer>[] g;
        int[] inq, d, p, a;

        void Init(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            e = new ArrayList<>();
            g = new ArrayList[n+1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        void add(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            e.add(new Edge(from, to, cap, 0, cost));
            e.add(new Edge(to, from, 0, 0, -cost));
            int m = e.size();
            g[from].add(m-2);
            g[to].add(m-1);
        }

        boolean bellman(int s, int t, int[] flow, int[] cost) {
            d = new int[t+1];
            inq = new int[t+1];
            p = new int[t+1];
            a = new int[t+1];
            Arrays.fill(d, INF);
            d[s] = 0;
            inq[s] = 1;
            p[s] = 0;
            a[s] = INF;
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.add(s);
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = Q.poll();
                inq[u] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
                    Edge ee = e.get(g[u].get(i));
                    if (ee.cap > ee.flow && d[ee.to] > d[u] + ee.cost) {
                        d[ee.to] = d[u] + ee.cost;
                        p[ee.to] = g[u].get(i);
                        a[ee.to] = Math.min(a[u], ee.cap - ee.flow);
                        if (inq[ee.to] == 0) {
                            Q.add(ee.to);
                            inq[ee.to] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (d[t] == INF) return false;
            flow[0] += a[t];
            cost[0] += d[t] * a[t];
            int u = t;
            while (u != s) {
                e.get(p[u]).flow += a[t];
                e.get(p[u] ^ 1).flow -= a[t];
                u = e.get(p[u]).from;
            }
            return true;
        }

        int minCost(int s, int t) {
            int[] flow = new int[1];
            int[] cost = new int[1];
            while (bellman(s, t, flow, cost));
            return cost[0];
        }
    }

    static int readInt() {
        int X = 0, w = 0;
        char ch = 0;
        try {
            while (true) {
                ch = (char) System.in.read();
                if (ch == -1) break;
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') break;
                if (ch == '-') w = 1;
            }
            while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                X = (X << 3) + (X << 1) + (ch - '0');
                ch = (char) System.in.read();
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {}
        return w == 1 ? -X : X;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = readInt();
        int m = readInt();
        int k = readInt();
        int c = readInt();
        int d = readInt();

        int[] a = new int[k+1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = readInt();
        }

        int startPoint = 0;
        int endPoint = n * 100 + 1;

        MCMF solve = new MCMF();
        solve.Init(endPoint);

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            solve.add(startPoint, 1 + (a[i]-1)*100, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                int p = (i-1)*100;
                solve.add(p+j, p+j+1, INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
            solve.add(i, endPoint, INF, 0);
        }

        while (m-- > 0) {
            int x = readInt();
            int y = readInt();
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                int p = (x-1)*100 + i;
                int pp = (y-1)*100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; j++) {
                    solve.add(p, pp, 1, d*(j*j - (j-1)*(j-1)) + c);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                int p = (y-1)*100 + i;
                int pp = (x-1)*100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; j++) {
                    solve.add(p, pp, 1, d*(j*j - (j-1)*(j-1)) + c);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solve.minCost(startPoint, endPoint));
    }
}
